name: Selection operations cover Marquee Box, Lasso, Magic Wand, and floating pixel movement
description: Verify drawing a solid colored circle, selecting regions with Marquee Box, Lasso, and Magic Wand, dragging floating selections to reposition artwork, and using selection modifiers.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool by pressing O, ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on the canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent solid circle
Select the Flood Fill tool (press G), choose a bright palette color, and click inside the circle to color it solidly
Verify a solid colored circle is rendered in the center of the canvas
Click the Marquee Box tool button in the left toolbar (or press M on keyboard)
Click and drag across the top-left quadrant of the circle to enclose it in a bounding box
Verify marching ants selection boundary outlines the selected box
Click and drag inside the selection box to lift and reposition the floating pixels
Verify the floating pixels move dynamically with the cursor to the new canvas position
Click the Magic Wand tool button in the left toolbar (or press W on keyboard)
Click on the colored circle on the canvas
Verify the contiguous colored circular shape is immediately selected by the magic wand
